minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed three ANR plans, continued the scenic road hearing, and backed buying 250 Howard Street.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed ANR plans for 27 The Clearing, 524 Northfield Road and 300 Holman Street West. It continued the scenic road and shared driveway hearing to 14 September, heard a Bright Farms pre-submission, and discussed abutter complaints about the 1325 Mass Ave berm and how decisions are drafted. It also discussed adding Board of Health input to the ANR process, recommended the Select Board seek 250 Howard Street, and approved prior minutes.

public_comment.topic: A member asked how public comment is handled, whether limited to non-agenda items. The board kept its current practice.
An abutter of 1325 Mass Ave said they wrote to the planning board, the building commissioner and the select board about the berm, and felt unheard at the select board meeting.

votes.motion: Endorse the ANR plan for 27 The Clearing
Approve the ANR plan for 524 Northfield Road
Approve the ANR for 300 Holman Street West
votes.outcome: passed 4-0 by roll call (the roll call shows Cole, Brenner, Torgerson and the chair)

votes.motion: Continue the scenic road public hearing to 14 September at 6:35

votes.outcome: passed; one member abstained as not present

votes.motion: Recommend that the Board of Selectmen seek to acquire 250 Howard Street
votes.outcome: passed; roll call as heard shows Cole, Bertram, Torgerson and the chair in favor

budget_items.what_was_said: The parcel under Chapter 61 right of first refusal is offered at a price roughly equal to the per-acre price paid for the Saliva parcel. The board called it below agricultural market value.
The applicant said the greenhouse would employ about 60 people at competitive wages, rising with a second phase.

budget_items.topic: Sewer capacity for the Bright Farms site
budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant cited an earlier sewer capacity agreement for the site and expects far lower use. A member cautioned that the earlier agreement may have expired.

budget_items.topic: Value of a new building lot
budget_items.what_was_said: Members noted that a new lot is worth a lot relative to the cost of an engineered plan.
The contract for the population study is going back to the Donahue Center, with results expected before year end.

decisions.decision: Board will keep its current public comment practice, with no agenda item to change it.
Applicant to return on 14 September with one engineered plan showing measured driveway locations and stone walls for the Brightman driveway and the shared driveway for lots 1 and 5.
Director to send the shared driveway plan to the fire chief, and the board hopes for Board of Health feedback.
Director to investigate legal limits and draft changes to the ANR process, including Board of Health input and dropping the abutters list, for the 14 September meeting.
A future agenda item on decision-drafting process and standard conditions.
Board leaned toward drafting decisions and voting on them at a later meeting, with decisions placed in the packet and agenda.
Rules and regulations workshop moved to October; 14 September will cover the ANR draft.
Director to put the low impact development language in the stormwater bylaw on the 14 September agenda.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to recommend that the Board of Selectmen seek to acquire 250 Howard Street; the roll call as heard shows four members in favor.
The board endorsed ANR plans for 27 The Clearing and 524 Northfield Road, each 5-0, and for 300 Holman Street West, 4-0.
The scenic road and shared driveway hearing on Northfield Road was continued to 14 September, 5-0; the applicant is to return with one engineered plan.
The director is to investigate legal limits and draft changes to the ANR process, including Board of Health input and dropping the abutters list, for 14 September.
The board heard a Bright Farms pre-submission and abutter complaints about the 1325 Mass Ave berm; no vote was taken, and a future agenda item on drafting decisions is planned.

why_it_matters: The 250 Howard Street recommendation goes to the Select Board, and a purchase of town land could mean a spending vote or a use decision for residents.
Changes to the ANR process, such as Board of Health input or dropping the abutters list, would change how lot divisions are reviewed and who is notified of them near a resident's property.
The Bright Farms greenhouse proposal touches local jobs and sewer capacity, and a member noted that an earlier sewer agreement may have expired.
watch_next: 14 September: the continued scenic road and shared driveway hearing, with the engineered plan, and the director's draft ANR process changes.
The stormwater bylaw low impact development language is on the 14 September agenda; the rules and regulations workshop moves to October.
